HMU - Sir is a gem. He teaches really well. Try to attend his class and take notes regularly. Sir is very much strict about the marking. But if you give efforts you can get a good grade. Some questions are little bit conceptual and some are direct from his lectures and slides. He gives some bonus mark in his classes but he don’t announce before. Sudden bonuses. So try to attend regularly. Two most important parts are try to get in a good group because sir himself don’t give the presentation marks. Basically he takes two presentations. Mark will be given by all the students of that section. It doesn’t matter that everyone has to give presentation. If one member can give a good presentation he can defiantly do that. Every member will get the same marks of a team. Another thing is he gives a lot of question in the exams. MCQ, true false, 1 line ans etc. but time will be short. So try to maintain time. Otherwise you will be panicked.
MRE - Everyone says he is female bias. Bus I did fin 254 under him with a decent grade.Sir gives the same thing in exam that he teaches in class. So if you can memories and practice same thing 2/3 times at the end you will definitely get a good grade.

SYS is literally like a wolf in sheep’s clothing. He talks continuously for 1 hour and 30 minutes without giving students even 5 seconds to process the topics. It feels like he’s teaching at 2.0x speed, and because of this nonstop pace, most students lose track after a while. While his explanations are somewhat clear, the mids and finals are completely different from what he teaches. The exam questions often feel unrelated to class lectures and he intentionally makes the papers so lengthy that its almost impossible to finish them on time. The math adjustments he uses are also very unusual and difficult to follow. In our class, most grades ranged from B to D and although he eventually curved the grades, it didn’t really help much.
